message.reasoning_content: Prices drop fast with selling; early rounds highest prices. I have 3 goods, opponents also hold goods and may sell. Cash devalues 62% each round, so spending cash later (bribes) matters — cash now loses value unless used. Selling now at high prices gives cash, but devaluation means better to hold goods? No, goods don't sell higher later. Sell all 3 now at 12+10+9=31.
